parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of deleting an index_together when there is a unique_together on the same fields, but it may introduce a behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch modifies the behavior of _delete_composed_index by adding a 'unique': False parameter, which may affect other parts of the code that rely on the existing behavior.
